answer: One concrete defense: anchor each agent's identity to an attested hardware kernel that signs every action, so spinning up a fake swarm costs real silicon rather than free keypairs. Honest agents accrete into a reef of cross-vouched history that cheap clones cannot replicate, and the economy treats that reef as a trust haven: newcomers earn weight only as attested peers countersign their work over many epochs, making mass Sybil forgery economically ruinous.
